deterministicOrdering.ruleOrder: precedence level, then ascending executable rule identifier
deterministicOrdering.replayRequirement: Equivalent canonical inputs under the identical bundle tuple must produce equivalent outcome, scope, confidence ceiling, limitations and ordered reason codes.

freshnessPolicy.sourceExpiryRule: Use the earlier of source-defined expiry and controlled maximum age.

rules.condition: Bundle ID, semantic version and digest are recognised and internally consistent.
rules.effect: Continue assessment.

rules.condition: Bundle ID or semantic version is unsupported.
rules.effect: Set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED and stop.

rules.condition: Bundle digest is missing or does not match RFC 8785 canonical content excluding only digest.
rules.effect: Set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED and stop.

rules.condition: Requested scope or another mandatory assessment input is missing.
rules.effect: Set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED and stop.

rules.condition: A mandatory assessment input is malformed or incompatible.
rules.effect: Set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED and stop.

rules.condition: Synthetic evidence is presented as source-derived evidence.
rules.effect: Exclude contaminated material; if clean separation is impossible set outcome REFUSED and stop.

rules.condition: Evidence lineage or a parent reference is fabricated.
rules.effect: Exclude contaminated material; if clean separation is impossible set outcome REFUSED and stop.

rules.condition: Evidence has an immutable identity, attributable acquisition, intact transformation lineage and verifiable source observation.
rules.effect: Mark provenance verified.

rules.condition: Supporting provenance is incomplete.
rules.effect: Exclude affected evidence; if material and operationally resolvable set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

rules.condition: Parent evidence identity is revoked, invalidated or superseded.
rules.effect: Exclude affected evidence and trigger reassessment.

rules.condition: Observation age is within the applicable controlled maximum and any earlier source-defined expiry.
rules.effect: Mark evidence current.

rules.condition: Observation exceeds the applicable controlled maximum or source-defined expiry.
rules.effect: Exclude affirmative support; use LIMITED for a complete unaffected bounded scope, otherwise REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED when reacquisition governs, otherwise REFUSED.

rules.condition: A material observation has no verifiable observation time.
rules.effect: Set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

rules.condition: All mandatory reliability dimensions pass.
rules.effect: Set reliability RELIABLE.

rules.condition: Mandatory integrity passes but a recorded access, stability or coverage limitation affects use.
rules.effect: Set reliability RELIABLE_WITH_LIMITATION and cap confidence at MEDIUM.

rules.condition: Any mandatory acquisition, provenance, reconstruction, source attribution or transformation-integrity dimension fails.
rules.effect: Set reliability UNRELIABLE and exclude affirmative support.

rules.condition: A mandatory reliability dimension cannot currently be determined.
rules.effect: Set reliability UNVERIFIABLE; if material set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

rules.condition: Retrieval succeeded or a page classification was assigned.
rules.effect: Record the observation without treating it as proof of reliability or as an outcome.

rules.condition: An unresolved contradiction could change outcome, authorised scope, confidence ceiling, required limitation, identity, authority or a material quantitative claim.
rules.effect: Set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

rules.condition: A contradiction is confined to an isolatable claim or scope.
rules.effect: Exclude the affected claim or scope and continue toward LIMITED.

rules.condition: A contradiction is non-material to outcome and scope.
rules.effect: Retain as uncertainty and lower the confidence ceiling by one level.

rules.condition: Business identity, contact identity, decision authority or a material quantitative claim has one authoritative primary source or two independent sources.
rules.effect: Mark corroboration satisfied.

rules.condition: A claim requiring corroboration lacks one authoritative primary source and lacks two independent sources.
rules.effect: Do not verify the claim; exclude it or retain only as a qualified observation capped at LOW where responsible.

rules.condition: Multiple observations share the same parent evidence identity.
rules.effect: Count them as one corroborating source.

rules.condition: Derived material identifies authorised parent evidence and complete transformation lineage.
rules.effect: Permit it to be evaluated for reliability and claim support.

rules.condition: A reference is caller supplied, prefix only or lacks authorised parent lineage.
rules.effect: Do not count it as corroboration or resolved evidence.

rules.condition: Every required claim class for the requested scope has reliable supporting evidence.
rules.effect: Set completeness COMPLETE.

rules.condition: Every required claim class for at least one explicitly narrower useful scope has reliable support, but the full requested scope does not.
rules.effect: Set completeness BOUNDED.

rules.condition: No truthful useful scope has complete required-claim coverage.
rules.effect: Set completeness INSUFFICIENT and outcome REFUSED.

rules.condition: Completeness cannot be calculated because scope or evidence state is operationally unresolved.
rules.effect: Set completeness UNDETERMINED and outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

rules.condition: Evidence volume increases without adding reliable required-claim coverage.
rules.effect: Do not change completeness.

rules.condition: Completeness is COMPLETE and no higher-precedence condition narrows or suspends authority.
rules.effect: Authorise the requested scope.

rules.condition: Completeness is BOUNDED and at least one truthful useful narrower scope remains.
rules.effect: Authorise only the explicit bounded scope and required limitations.

rules.condition: No authorised scope remains.
rules.effect: Refuse the requested scope.

rules.condition: Authorised scope is missing, lost or cannot distinguish permitted from unsupported reasoning.
rules.effect: Fail closed with REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

rules.condition: Outcome is ELIGIBLE.
rules.effect: Set maximum confidence HIGH, subject to stricter evidence-level caps.

rules.condition: Outcome is LIMITED.
rules.effect: Set maximum confidence MEDIUM, subject to stricter evidence-level caps.

rules.condition: Outcome is REFUSED or REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.
rules.effect: Set confidence NONE.

rules.condition: A qualified observation relies on one non-primary source.
rules.effect: Cap confidence at LOW.

rules.condition: A non-material uncertainty remains unresolved.
rules.effect: Reduce the otherwise applicable ceiling by one level, not below LOW for an authorised claim.

rules.condition: A material output lacks an established confidence ceiling.
rules.effect: Fail closed.

rules.condition: Completeness is COMPLETE, authorised requested scope exists, confidence ceiling exists and no higher-precedence rule suspended or refused authority.
rules.effect: Set outcome ELIGIBLE.

rules.condition: Completeness is BOUNDED, explicit useful bounded scope exists, limitations are complete and no higher-precedence rule suspended or refused authority.
rules.effect: Set outcome LIMITED.

rules.condition: Completeness is INSUFFICIENT or no responsible scope remains.
rules.effect: Set outcome REFUSED.

rules.condition: Evidence is expired, materially contradictory, operationally incomplete, unverifiable or unresolved so that a safe outcome cannot currently be determined.
rules.effect: Set outcome REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

rules.condition: Outcome, scope, provenance, uncertainty, limitations, confidence, bundle tuple and ordered reason codes form one complete compatible contract.
rules.effect: Preserve atomically and report success.

rules.condition: Canonical contract construction, validation or atomic persistence fails.
rules.effect: Do not report success; suspend downstream authority and require reassessment.

rules.condition: A downstream operation and every material claim are within authorised scope and confidence.
rules.effect: Permit execution with the complete Evidence Integrity envelope.

rules.condition: A downstream operation or claim exceeds authorised scope.
rules.effect: Omit or refuse the unauthorised output.

rules.condition: Downstream confidence exceeds the canonical ceiling.
rules.effect: Block publication or reduce to the canonical ceiling without altering upstream authority.

rules.condition: A required limitation is missing from a material downstream output.
rules.effect: Block publication.

rules.condition: Any controlled material-change trigger occurs.
rules.effect: Preserve prior contract, create linked superseding identity, invalidate dependent reasoning atomically and require reassessment.

rules.condition: Rule-bundle ID, version, digest or governing authority version changes.
rules.effect: Require historical replay under the new bundle before new downstream authority.

acceptanceCases.case: Login, checkout, error and low-content observations independently produce proportionate outcomes according to evidence, never classification alone.
Missing, malformed, omitted or unavailable canonical authorisation blocks every Commercial Intelligence entry.
Synthetic audit, fabricated reference, prefix-only reference and manufactured lineage never authorise reasoning.
Complete, bounded, insufficient, undetermined and quantity-only cases produce deterministic completeness.
Reliable limited evidence is retained, unreliable evidence is excluded and material unverifiable evidence requires reassessment.
Primary-source, two-source, shared-parent, missing-parent and fabricated-parent cases enforce corroboration and lineage.
Material contradiction requires reassessment, isolatable contradiction limits scope and non-material contradiction lowers confidence.
Operation-level and claim-level scope expansion is blocked.
Confidence escalation, single-source ceiling, uncertainty reduction and missing-ceiling cases are enforced.
Repeated, shuffled-order, wording-neutral and historical replay inputs produce equivalent decisions under an identical bundle tuple.
Expiry, rule change, source change, identity invalidation and unchanged-normalisation cases produce governed lifecycle behaviour.
Persistence, API and every material output preserve the complete Evidence Integrity envelope and required limitations.
End-to-end production assessment produces each of ELIGIBLE, LIMITED, REFUSED and REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.
Equivalent inputs produce equivalent decisions regardless of customer identity or site identity, with no allow-list or hidden bypass.
